title: Contrast-enhanced Mammography: State of the Art

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Contrast-enhanced Mammography: State of the Art》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) has emerged as a viable alternative to contrast-enhanced breast MRI, and it may increase access to vascular imaging while reducing examination cost.

evidence.text: Contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) has emerged as a viable alternative to contrast-enhanced breast MRI, and it may increase access to vascular imaging while reducing examination cost.
